title: Error Handling, Regular Expressions, and Performance
objectives: Master error handling patterns, regex, and JavaScript performance profiling.
theory_markdown:
Error handling: `try/catch/finally`, custom error classes, async error handling. Never swallow errors silently. Log with context. `Error.captureStackTrace` for V8.

Regular expressions: `test()`, `match()`, `replace()`, `matchAll()`, named capture groups, lookahead/lookbehind. Performance: avoid `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify())` for deep clone, use `structuredClone()`. Debounce and throttle expensive operations.

code_walkthrough.explanation: Custom errors carry semantic meaning and status codes. Regex named groups make matches readable. Debounce limits function calls during rapid events. `structuredClone` is the modern deep clone solution.

ai_tool_spotlight.description: Use **BrowserStack** or **Lighthouse** to profile JavaScript performance. Use **Regex101.com** (free) to test regex patterns.
